findings.justification: The frozen ledger disposition is retained as evidence-origin provenance only; apply never copies an envelope and every row receives the same distinct attestation class. All 78 exact bases were nevertheless certified true.

Detached operation cannot synchronously report terminal verification. The locked legacy field retains its shape and reports accepted scheduling; exact drive state is additive metadata plus the durable outcome.
The operator-only local helper uses a PID/SHA path with O_EXCL-like notes application sequencing; random-temp hardening is non-blocking and outside the acceptance surface.
RC-01 explicitly scopes child calls in svc-reconcile; detached spawn is intentionally non-waiting and backlog-helper processes are bounded by finite local Git/Node operations.
Responsibility B emits only unverified candidates, so false is the correct wiring; the predicate remains reusable and independently state-matrix tested.
The fixture deliberately isolates the GitHub hang path; Responsibility A has separate live-range equality evidence.
